request.question: Explain how train.py trains the model and when it stops.
request.scope: train.py run as a script, from the entry block to the result file.
request.configuration: Config JSON named by the first command-line argument; the file is not in the workspace, so its values are unresolved.

nodes.label: Load config file and call train
nodes.detail: Reads the JSON config named by the first command-line argument.

nodes.label: Build model
nodes.detail: Model(width) from the external toolkit package.

nodes.label: Shuffled batch loader
nodes.detail: Loader over the configured data with the configured batch size and shuffle=True.

nodes.label: Best score and wait counter
nodes.detail: Starts at infinity and 0; set to the new score and 0 on improvement, otherwise the counter grows by one.

nodes.label: Epoch loop
nodes.detail: Runs at most the configured number of epochs and leaves early when patience is exhausted.

nodes.label: Update model on each batch
nodes.detail: Calls model.update(x, y, lr) for every batch of the epoch.

nodes.label: Parameters change in place
nodes.detail: model.update is library code outside the workspace. That it changes the parameters later batches and validation use is inferred from how the model object is reused, not read.

nodes.label: Compute val_loss on validation data
nodes.detail: Once per epoch, after all batches; a lower value counts as an improvement.

nodes.label: Track best, test patience
nodes.detail: Updates the best score and wait counter, then breaks when the counter reaches the configured patience.

nodes.label: Write best score and epoch count
nodes.detail: JSON file at the configured output path with the best val_loss and the number of epochs run.

edges.label: new best and counter 0, or counter + 1
patience left: next epoch; best score, counter and model object carry over
